description:
My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the market this spacious, fully furnished en-suite room, available immediately within a well maintained house share on Derwent Water Street in South Shields

This modern house share offers comfortable and convenient living, making it an excellent choice for working professionals. The available room is fully furnished with all the essential furniture, allowing you to move in with ease. The private en-suite bathroom provides added comfort and privacy.

Residents also have access to a well equipped shared kitchen, complete with a range of appliances and ample storage, as well as a welcoming communal living room.

All utility bills are included within the rent, including gas, electricity, water, council tax and Wi-Fi, providing hassle free living with no unexpected monthly costs. On-street parking is available directly outside the property.

Ideally situated on Derwent Water Street, the property benefits from excellent access to South Shields town centre, local shops, supermarkets, cafés, restaurants and leisure facilities. There are also excellent transport links nearby, including bus routes and the Metro, making commuting throughout South Tyneside and into Newcastle quick and convenient.
